pages.text: $(bold)Observer$() — pulses when the watched block changes (growth, a piston, a sign edit). $(bold)Target Block$() — outputs a signal whose strength depends on how close an arrow (or trident) hits the centre. A redstone dartboard.
pages.title: Watchers

pages.text: $(italic)Quark's$() $(bold)Ender Watcher$() is the odd one: it fires when a $(italic)player looks at it$(). Hide one in a wall to trip a trap when someone meets its gaze.
pages.title: Ender Watcher
